purpose: Prevent verification drift, hidden capability loss, authority collapse, repeated work, unsafe mutations, and blocked-route churn while maximizing material plugin-mesh progress.

rules.effect: Fresh provider-native evidence cannot be demoted by stale aggregate projections.
Skip VERIFIED core surfaces absent regression signal or explicit recheck.
Retry transient blockers only after provider-state change or a materially different route.
Blockers change route, not objective; preserve the unresolved scope explicitly.
VERIFIED_WRITE requires provider acceptance, independent owning-provider readback, and explicit verified scope.
Verification applies only to the exercised action/surface and cannot be generalized to unrelated capability.
Never guess among multiple provider accounts or workspaces in non-interactive execution.
Security mutations require a fresh state read, legitimate access-path recovery, explicit intended roles, and a post-change readback plan.
Compare a failed deployment commit to current source before repairing source; stale failures cannot prove current source is broken.
A successful run must verify a new capability, repair a real seam, or strengthen a reusable coalition; inventory-only and prose-only runs do not count.

Operator-reported facts, provider facts, memory projections, and inference are distinct authority domains. Lack of provider recovery never erases a fact carried in another legitimate authority domain.
A failed retrieval or zero matches from incomplete coverage is not proof of absence. Preserve RETRIEVAL_GAP or NO_MATCH_IN_PARTIAL_COVERAGE.
Fallbacks must declare lost capabilities. A weaker route is DEGRADED_FALLBACK, never silently equivalent.
Connector projections must preserve protected semantics such as authority, provenance, contradictions, and evidence state; otherwise block and report the lost fields.
For reversible mutations, capture pre-state, know the rollback route, and carry an idempotency key before mutation.
A stronger state may be demoted only by disconfirming provider-native evidence for the same scope. Missing/weaker evidence cannot demote; scope changes require a split state.
A connector projection or fallback may not silently widen PRIVATE/RESTRICTED material into a less restrictive boundary. Preserve the boundary or require explicit declassification/redaction.

hidden_harm_counter_engineering.objective: Detect and prevent silent losses that can occur even when individual connector claims are technically truthful.
hidden_harm_counter_engineering.counter_pattern: DETECT LOSS -> NAME LOST DIMENSION -> PRESERVE STRONGER STATE -> ROUTE AROUND -> VERIFY -> PERSIST
